description_en: Retrieves the model deployment configuration file (EAS InferenceSpec)
description_zh: 获取模型部署的配置文件（ EAS InferenceSpec）
kebab_example: aliyun paimodelgallery get-model-deployment-spec --model-id model-gfo1kjy000dbw4fa37 --model-version 1.0.0 --workspace-id 295949 --profile-id prf_5cd37a1c7eaa000c6829dbb02 --api-version 2026-06-03 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetModelDeploymentSpec

parameters.help_en: The ID of the model to deploy. This value must be the same as the one used in the request to obtain the ProfileId (ListModelDeploymentProfiles)
parameters.help_zh: 实际部署模型 ID。与获取 ProfileId（ListModelDeploymentProfiles）时请求一致
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.help_en: The model version. This value must be the same as the ModelVersion in the response when obtaining the ProfileId (ListModelDeploymentProfiles)
parameters.help_zh: 模型版本。与获取 ProfileId（ListModelDeploymentProfiles）时响应中 ModelVersion 一致
parameters.name: model_version

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html to obtain the workspace ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The business rule key. This value must be the same as the one used in the request to obtain the ProfileId (ListModelDeploymentProfiles)
parameters.help_zh: 业务规则键。与获取 ProfileId（ListModelDeploymentProfiles）时请求一致
parameters.name: biz_key

parameters.help_en:
A URL-encoded JSON array of ResourceSelection objects. If omitted, the template resources are not overridden.
JSON field description:
MemberType: string, optional. The target member type. If specified, the value must match Profiles[].Members[].MemberType. If omitted, members are assigned in the order of unbound members in the Profile.
ResourceType: string, optional. The resource category of the caller. This field is for logging purposes only and is not used for backend matching or validation.
InstanceType: string, optional. The instance type for public resources or spot instances.
ResourceId: string, optional. The ID of the dedicated resource group.
QuotaId: string, optional. The quota ID.
QuotaType: string, optional. The quota type. When using a quota, the caller passes through this value from the response of the Quota API.

If multiple resource fields are specified for the same item, the rendering priority is QuotaId, ResourceId, and then InstanceType. ResourceType does not affect this priority
parameters.help_zh:
URL 编码后的 ResourceSelection JSON 数组；省略时不覆盖模板资源。
JSON字段说明：
MemberType：string，选填。目标成员类型；填写时应与 Profiles[].Members[].MemberType 一致。省略时按 Profile 未绑定成员的顺序分配。
ResourceType：string，选填。调用方资源分类，仅用于记录；不参与后端匹配或校验。
InstanceType：string，选填。公共资源或 Spot 实例规格。
ResourceId：string，选填。专属资源组 ID。
QuotaId：string，选填。Quota ID。
QuotaType：string，选填。Quota 类型；使用 Quota 时由调用方从 Quota 接口返回值透传。

同一项同时传入多个具体资源字段时，渲染优先级为 QuotaId、ResourceId、InstanceType。ResourceType 不决定该优先级
parameters.name: resource_selections

InferenceSpec.description_en: The EAS deployment template, represented as an open object. For the format, see [JSON deployment]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450525.html）
InferenceSpec.description_zh: EAS 部署模板，采用开放对象。 格式参见[JSON部署]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450525.html）
